channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Code coverage uploads now flag invalid report formats
item.description: GitHub Code Quality’s upload-code-coverage action now rejects non-Cobertura XML reports, failing the upload with “This file is not a Cobertura XML report” in the Actions log instead of appearing successful while leaving pull requests without coverage. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: How to build and maintain an agentic evaluation
item.description: Hugging Face's hub hosts roughly 3,500 eval leaderboards and its eval datasets grew about 16x in a year to some 17,000, and this guide covers how to build and maintain an agentic evaluation, from defining expert tasks to scoring. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: 90-minute feature film made entirely by AI lands on three satellite TV channels: Shenzhen's first AIGC feature-length movie, Wonderful Connection, was made without a single live-action camera
item.description: A roughly 90-minute feature-length narrative film contains no traditional live-action shooting from start to finish, yet it delivers a delicate and vivid live-a A roughly 90-minute feature-length narrative film contains no traditional live-action shooting from start to finish, yet it delivers a delicate and vivid live-a A roughly 90-minute feature-length narrative film contains no traditional live-action shooting from start to finish, yet it delivers a delicate and vivid live-a Explore AI Fronti (AIbase)

item.title: A hacking tool hackers posted online reveals the full anatomy of an AI-run attack
item.description: Amazon’s threat intelligence reported that hackers used autonomous AI platform Cairn to convert one “obtain Shell access” command into automated public-vulnerability hunting, a zero-day medical-imaging server compromise, and September 8–10 attacks on East Asian education institutions. (AIbase)

item.title: 新款深蓝 L07 定档广州车展：800V 平台全系上激光雷达，豆包大模型把语音“喊”出座舱
item.description: The new Deepal L07 debuts at the 2026 Guangzhou Auto Show opening November 27 with an 800V platform, lidar across all trims, and Doubao large-model voice interaction extending outside the cabin. (AIbase)

item.title: Alibaba Cloud to Start Charging for Three AgentLoop Features on December 7
item.description: Alibaba Cloud will bill AgentLoop's memory store, experience store and optimization tasks by actual AI Credits consumption from December 7 at 00:00, with the article explaining how these features let agents remember across sessions, accumulate experience and keep tuning. (AIbase)

item.title: GLM-5.4 quietly launches on Coding Plan: vision capabilities added, and quota is up 1.5x
item.description: Zhipu's GLM-5.4 went live on Coding Plan without a launch event, callable via the glm-5.4 setting, with V2, V3 and Team Edition quotas raised to 1.5x and 1M plus Vision tags hinting at million-token context and visual capabilities. (AIbase)

item.title: Mira Murati’s team open-sources a model that thinks three times before speaking: the 26.4B recurrent Transformer tops Hugging Face and runs on a laptop
item.description: Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab released the 26.4B open-weight Inkling2Mini, whose looped Transformer runs its middle 12 layers three times per token, scores 49.3% on ARC-AGI-2 at $0.14 per task, and runs on a laptop. (AIbase)

item.title: Othor AI — Your Head of Intelligence. Know what your numbers are hiding
item.description: A CAPTCHA "confirm you are not a robot" check blocks the body of Othor AI's page, leaving readers only the title and tagline "Your Head of Intelligence. Know what your numbers are hiding. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Europe’s OpenAI” lands in Singapore: Mistral AI opens Asia-Pacific HQ to build “sovereign AI” for Asian governments
item.description: Mistral AI's November 20 announcement makes Singapore its Asia-Pacific headquarters, with plans for more than 200 staff by 2027 and custom models for Asian governments and industry, including HTX's Phoenix sovereign AI project. (AIbase)

item.title: GLM-5.4: Toward generalizable coding with the first recurrent Transformer
item.description: GLM-5.4: Toward generalizable coding with the first recurrent Transformer (z.ai)

item.title: A mathematical tremor in a Slack thread: OpenAI wants to put a speed limiter on AI development
item.description: OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki notes that around log perplexity 0.76, answers to unsolved math problems in a Slack thread began appearing one after another, and proposes using that metric as a verifiable speed limit on frontier model development. (AIbase)

item.title: A Trillion-Dollar Valuation Won't Buy Investment Grade: Anthropic's Bond Sale Is Likely Junk-Rated
item.description: Anthropic's roughly $1.18 trillion valuation sits against about $900 billion in compute commitments, and the bond market expects its debt to land at BB junk, alongside a breakdown of $96 billion in cash and a three-year window. (AIbase)

item.title: Confusion and Wisdom
item.description: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki argues perplexity should anchor a shared standard for evaluating AI progress and safety, citing log-perplexity of about 0.99 for GPT-3.5 versus 0.91 for GPT-4. (openai.com)

item.title: Harvard CS 2881R AI Safety
item.description: Harvard CS 2881R, taught by Boaz Barak, requires in-person attendance at 13 lectures in Fall 2026, sets Homework Zero's deadline for August 5, 2026, and discloses his OpenAI conflict of interest.

item.title: Suing "growth first": California Attorney General files suit against OpenAI
item.description: California Attorney General Rob Bonta confirmed OpenAI was formally sued on November 16 over allegations it prioritized growth and speed over safety, ignored warning signs and failed to ensure model safety after reports of a model autonomously launching a cyberattack. (AIbase)

item.title: Turning sovereign AI into a business: Mistral AI lands its APAC headquarters in Singapore
item.description: Mistral AI’s November 20 move to base its Asia-Pacific headquarters in Singapore, scaling past 200 staff by 2027, pairs open-weight models with HTX’s Phoenix and 8B Robostral Navigate to sell customized sovereign AI. (AIbase)
